  • Can Buy or Not

    Can Buy

    One of the most striking features of the ROG Azoth Extreme is its tiny OLED meant to provide information at a glance. The touchscreen display shows you when you are using the dial to adjust settings like keyboard brightness or control volume. To fine tune settings, you can use Asus' Armoury Crate software. Aside from customising what's shown on the OLED, Armoury Crate also lets you create macros, customise keys, lighting effects, and so on. It isn't the prettiest or most user-friendly piece of software, but gets the job done.
